title: Native checkout preparation must recover stale Git index locks
body: The queued bash tools/vixen-native.sh --lane gpuwin-ledger prepare failed after cloning because /mnt/c/vixen-native/gpuwin-ledger/.git/index.lock already existed. I verified no Git process owned it, then reran prepare successfully after the stale lock disappeared. Make native preparation serialize or safely diagnose and recover stale index locks for its own checkout instead of requiring a lane retry.

title: Expose UNDERSET_NATIVE_BENCHMARK in the native build contract
body: The documented queued native target build configured vixen-ninja-release with UNDERSET_NATIVE_BENCHMARK=OFF, so the first successful capture emitted no perf.csv or benchmark HOSTWAIT ledger. Recovery required an untracked benchmark-configure.bat that discovered vcvars64 and ran CMake with -DUNDERSET_NATIVE_BENCHMARK=ON, followed by a second queued rebuild. Make the native preset or tools/vixen-native.sh expose the measurement keyword as a first-class configure option and make the capture contract reject an uninstrumented binary.

title: Provide a lane-configurable native look-dev capture helper
body: The reused run-capture.bat hardcoded C:\vixen-native\goldnative1, a fixed output root, and did not consume the requested state/angle/extent arguments. To run this lane I copied it into the assigned checkout and adapted the executable root, evidence root, VIXEN_PERF_CSV, VIXEN_PHASE_TIMING, state, angle, frame count, and width/height parsing by hand. Provide one canonical native capture helper with lane root, output root, scene, angle, frame count, and extent parameters.

title: Native target build should configure its preset when the binary directory is absent
body: The required queued command bash tools/vixen-native.sh --lane gpuwin-ledger build build vixen-ninja-release vixen_lookdev_capture failed before compilation because build/ninja-release did not exist. I had to run a separate queued configure step and then retry the exact target build. Make the native build entry point provision the requested preset when its binary directory is missing, or report the exact supported configure command as part of the same contract.
